1.why: Text is a clean sans-serif with ample line height and short lines, though letter spacing looks default rather than explicitly expanded.

2.why: All copy across the four screens is sentence-case with no italics, no all-caps labels, and no paragraph longer than a single line.

3.why: The narrow single-column card layout with full-width buttons and large fields reads cleanly and would fit a phone, but I only observed one viewport width.

4.why: Instructions are single short plain sentences such as 'Sign in to begin. Take your time.' and 'Enter the same contact details again.'

5.why: Placeholders ('name@example.com', '07123 456789') and demo hints model every visible input, but no example is ever shown for OTP or recovery-code entry because those screens never load.

6.why: The longest content anywhere is a one-line sentence; even the Logs panel shows single-line messages, so no screen requires reading a long block of text.

7.why: No copy-to-clipboard control appears on any screen, and the flow crashes at step 2 so codes are never presented in a copyable form.

8.why: No QR code or equivalent alternative is offered anywhere; the authenticator provisioning screen never renders due to the 'Invalid array length' failure.

9.why: The email, phone, and password fields are standard labeled inputs that password managers could plausibly fill, but nothing in the screenshots confirms autocomplete attributes or one-time-code autofill.

10.why: The header always shows the position ('Step 2 of 6 · Confirm identity') and a single large blue button is the visually dominant element on each screen.

11.why: Each screen presents exactly one primary button ('Sign in and continue' / 'Confirm my identity') with no competing actions.

12.why: Sign-in was confirmed plainly ('You are signed in. Next, confirm your identity.'), but the confirm action only yielded the cryptic 'Invalid array length' banner with no explanation of what happened or what to do next.

13.why: Retry is explicitly offered ('You can retry any step', 'You can correct and retry these details') and exercised without penalty, but no reveal, hide, or re-request code controls exist because the code screens never appear.

14.why: The only error shown is the raw technical message 'Invalid array length', which states neither the problem in user terms nor how to fix it.

15.why: The app explicitly states 'No reading timer. You can retry any step.' and 'Take your time.', and no countdown or expiry indicator appears on any screen.
